fi|ffec4a2b66c3f26c.en: The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health was preparing a draft Board of Directors' proposal to amend the requirements of the Act on the secondary use of social and health data concerning secure environments for use in the field of data protection, in order to enable the use of Finnish register data in international research cooperation to be secure.
